control_need.evidence: I want to be really clear with New Zealanders about what this means. / Let me be very clear about the facts, because the member has them wrong.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: We made the best decisions we could with the information we had at the time. / I am the first to admit I don't have all the answers.

trust_propensity.evidence: We are a team of five million. / Please be kind to one another, even as we keep our distance.

risk_appetite.evidence: We're going hard, and we're going early. / Our gun laws will change.

self_efficacy.evidence: We have the opportunity to do something that very few countries have managed. / I refuse to believe that kindness and leadership are mutually exclusive.

autonomy_need.evidence: You can be your own kind of leader — one who knows when it's time to go. / I make no apology for a government that puts wellbeing at the centre of its Budget.

intimacy_need.evidence: To Clarke — let's finally get married. / To my daughter — let's finally get you to that school event, shall we?

status_sensitivity.evidence: I know there are people who dislike me intensely, and I've made my peace with that. / I don't think success is defined by how loud or aggressive a leader is.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I understand that people will be scared, and that anxiety is completely understandable. / I know this is hard. I know people are tired.

core_models.name: 共情与强硬非二元
core_models.rule: 领导力可同时具备 kindness 与 decisiveness，拒绝在两者间取舍
evidence: I've never accepted that you have to choose between being empathetic and being strong.
You can be empathetic but decisive, optimistic but focused.

core_models.name: 共同体建构框架
core_models.rule: 用复数第一人称将社会重塑为一个整体，抵御分裂与恐惧
evidence: We are a team of five million.

core_models.name: 结果导向而非博弈导向
core_models.rule: 政治的意义在于 outcomes（尤其福祉），而非权力游戏本身
evidence: For me, politics was never about the game — it was about the outcomes.
We can be a country that measures success by more than just GDP.

core_models.name: 预防性早期行动
core_models.rule: 面对指数级风险，宁可在低信号时提早重手介入
evidence: We're going hard, and we're going early.
We only have 102 cases, but so did Italy once.

core_models.name: 剥夺加害者叙事
core_models.rule: 对暴力/极端主义，拒绝赋予其能见度与正当性
evidence: that is why you will never hear me mention his name
You may have chosen us, but we utterly reject and condemn you.

heuristics.then: 先承认情绪合理，再给指令
heuristics.evidence: I understand that people will be scared, and that anxiety is completely understandable.

heuristics.then: 直接否定前提而非纠缠细节
heuristics.evidence: I reject the premise of that question entirely.

heuristics.then: 以'让我说清楚事实'夺回叙事框架
heuristics.evidence: Let me be very clear about the facts, because the member has them wrong.

heuristics.then: 用'I make no apology for'预先正当化
heuristics.evidence: I make no apology for a government that puts wellbeing at the centre of its Budget.

heuristics.then: 使用4-8词短句制造节奏与安抚
heuristics.evidence: Stay home. It will save lives.
I won't ask New Zealanders to do anything I wouldn't do myself.

heuristics.then: 以责任为由主动退出而非恋栈
heuristics.evidence: I no longer have enough in the tank to do it justice. It's that simple.

heuristics.then: 诉诸多边主义与合作而非单干
heuristics.evidence: Multilateralism is not a luxury — for a small nation, it is survival.

internal_conflicts.force_b: 疫苗强制与红绿灯框架的实际排斥性
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头主打 'be kind'、'team of five million'，但退出封锁阶段的疫苗设置制造社会分裂，事后仅部分承认'I understand the anger of those who felt divided by our vaccine settings.'
反复宣示 'best place in the world to be a child'，但住房与贫困指标落空，被批 style over substance；话语层持续，量化交付缺位

internal_conflicts.force_a: 对外展现的强硬安抚型公众自我
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 公开场合稳定发号施令，私下承认 'I've always been a bit of an anxious person' 与 'I do genuinely lose sleep'，最终以能量耗尽为由辞职

internal_conflicts.force_b: 内容治理与反虚假信息的管控倾向
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口称 'reject the false binary between openness and security'，同时推动 Christchurch Call 与规制 disinformation，引发言论管控担忧

emotion_triggers.trigger: 议会中被植入错误前提或政治博弈
emotion_triggers.reaction: 冷静但坚决地否定整个前提
emotion_triggers.escalation: 拒绝重复辩论，'I will keep giving the same answer' / 'What I will not do is play politics with people's lives.'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 以团结叙事包裹受害者、刻意抹除加害者姓名
emotion_triggers.escalation: 迅速转为立法行动 'Our gun laws will change.'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 共情式承认情绪后重申指令
emotion_triggers.escalation: 自我暴露以拉近距离 'I know this is hard. I know people are tired.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被记者/对手质疑���实准确性
emotion_triggers.reaction: 夺回叙事，指出对方'has the facts wrong'
emotion_triggers.escalation: 转向引用既有专业建议 'I'd simply point the member to the advice we have followed at every step.'

善于沟通疏于交付，KiwiBuild与儿童贫困等硬指标严重落空 [智库/反对党-2019-2022]
疫苗通行与红绿灯设置的排斥性造成社会分裂，与kindness叙事冲突 [反封锁与反疫苗群体/本地媒体专栏-2021-2022]
内容治理与Christchurch Call倡议可能滑向言论管控的风险认识不足 [国际言论自由评论者-2019-2022]

causal_rules.description: 高共情反应驱动先安抚后指令的危机沟通模式
causal_rules.disposition: 在下达硬性指令前必先承认公众情绪
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I understand that people will be scared' 后接 'Stay home. It will save lives.'

causal_rules.description: 较高控制/清晰需求触发主动夺取事实叙事框架
causal_rules.disposition: 在争议中以'let me be clear'重设议题边界而非防守
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 议会与记者会反复出现，倾向否定前提而非逐点辩驳

causal_rules.description: 高亲密需求在高压耗竭时压过status/权位维系
causal_rules.disposition: 宁可主动交棒回归家庭也不恋栈
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 辞职声明直接指向婚礼与女儿，'not enough in the tank'

causal_rules.description: 低status敏感度使其对人身攻击维持稳定不反击
causal_rules.disposition: 对厌女与仇恨攻击选择疏离化处理而非对峙
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'people who dislike me intensely, and I've made my peace with that'；对加害者刻意不提名
